decisions.reason: This optical spectrum connectivity service strongly leverages our fibre, network engineering and high-bandwidth capabilities, and its increased prominence on the website suggests we can learn from early demand and improve it within our software-defined infrastructure strategy.

The voice number ordering portal builds on our software platforms and operational know-how, fits our move toward real-time provisioning and support, and its continued presence indicates enough market relevance to justify further refinement.

Carrier pre-selection is close to our legacy voice knowledge but is weakly aligned with our growth path toward integrated software-defined infrastructure, and its disappearance from the website signals limited traction and low value from further learning.

Although direct voice network connection uses familiar capabilities, the early loss of website visibility suggests poor market momentum and it is less central to our cloud- and data-led strategy than other network products.
